purpose: find the invoice lines due in a date range (Q1 by month, B2) without reading every line. Q1 over the whole window (B1) is the control: it reads every line, so the index should not be used.
definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_invoice_line_due_unit ON lue_dw.fact_rent_invoice_line (due_date_key, unit_key)

purpose: the same for the payments against those lines (Q1 by month, B2; control B1).
definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_payment_due_unit ON lue_dw.fact_payment (due_date_key, unit_key)

purpose: one unit's days in a date range (B5), and the per-unit order of the vacancy islands (Q7). The pack's own proposal (docs/phase1/sql/physical_model.sql); on the parent it is created on every partition.
definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_occupancy_unit_date ON lue_dw.fact_unit_occupancy_daily (unit_key, snapshot_date_key)

purpose: the current tenant versions by segment (B6), a partial index on the current SCD2 rows only.
definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_dim_tenant_current_segment ON lue_dw.dim_tenant (tenant_type, employer_sector) WHERE is_current
load_slice: not measured: a dimension referenced by the facts
